messages:
ana_sales: FYI the FinTech prospect pushed back — they need hard guarantees that inference and logs for the POC will stay in the EU (no cross-border routing). Asking for list of subprocessors too.
leo_se: Got it. Which EU region are they in? eu-west-1 (aws) or eu-central?
ana_sales: They said EU (Germany) and mentioned compliance team wants eu-central specifically.
leo_se: Hosted API defaults to nearest region unless you set `region` header. We have a routing mode `strict_residency` we can enable for the customer to refuse any non-EU placement. Example config:```json
{"routing": {"mode": "strict_residency", "allowed_regions": ["eu-central-1"]}}
```
maria_privsec: Important: strict_residency prevents fallback to other regions. If capacity exhausted requests will 429. We need to confirm the SLA tradeoff with the customer. Also they asked subprocessors — I can attach the most recent subprocessor register (includes AWS EU regions, Datadog EU, Sentry EU).
sam_sre: Note on logs: application-level request logs are stored in the configured region, but metrics and aggregated telemetry sent to Datadog (EU tenancy) — I'll verify that our Datadog setup is EU-only for this account.
integration-bot: Deployment plan for POC submitted: image:v3 -> cluster eu-central-1, routing policy=strict_residency, retention=30d (logs). PR: https://git.internal/r/1234
leo_se: Two quick asks for the demo: 1) Can we get a restriction toggle enabled on the hosted tenant so the sales demo never routes outside EU? 2) Can we provide the subprocessors CSV for legal?
maria_privsec: I will prepare the subprocessors CSV (latest export) + a short cover note on data flows. Also will add a snippet about key management: customer keys stay in their KMS if they go Private; hosted uses our KMS in EU — flag that in the doc.
nana_sales: Customer wants pricing for Dedicated if strict residency means risk of 429s. Can we sketch run-rate for a 10k qps POC vs Hosted with strict?
\eo_leo: For Dedicated we can offer reserved pool in eu-central; I'll put together a rough numbers sheet (gpu hours, burst buffer). ETA EOD tomorrow.
nana_sales: Great. I'll loop in the customer to schedule a call after we confirm subprocessor CSV + pricing. Thanks :thumbsup:
maria_privsec: Uploading CSV now, will post link here when done.
integration-bot: File uploaded: /secure/subprocessors_export_2026-03-21.csv (eu-only flagging applied)
sam_sre: Quick technical note for the POC runbook — include these checks: 1) region header in requests, 2) health-checks to verify no cross-region egress, 3) monitor 429 rate for routing enforcement.
leo_se: I'll draft the POC runbook and a short script to validate egress (curl + tcpdump) and post it here.
nana_sales: Perfect. I'll set up the customer call for Friday 10:00 CET.
maria_privsec: Added the subprocessors CSV link and a short cover note: "We restrict processing to eu-central-1 under routing mode `strict_residency`. Subprocessors used for this tenant are: AWS eu-central-1, Datadog (EU tenancy), Sentry (EU), SendGrid (EU), our backups partner (EU-only)."
leo_se: Thanks — we'll be ready for the call.
nana_sales: End of thread, prepping materials.
